中文描述: 一直用手機拍照，直到朋友借我一台全幅机去街拍一下午。
英文翻译: I had been taking photos with my phone until a friend lent me a full-frame camera for street photography for an entire afternoon.

中文描述: 对焦速度和夜拍的干净程度让我回不去。
英文翻译: The autofocus speed and the clarity of night shots made me want to switch permanently.

中文描述: 隔周就下订了同款的二手机身，镜头先买一颗定焦。
英文翻译: The following week, I ordered the same model as a used body and bought a fixed lens first.
